# The Meat Agent (Meat Direct)

> Australian direct-to-consumer and wholesale butcher. Farm-gate allocation of MSA-graded beef, Wagyu MB9+, lamb, pork, chicken, smallgoods, seafood, kangaroo/game, veal, and curated meat boxes, with cold-chain courier delivery across Australia (QLD, NSW, VIC). Legal entity: LPJH HOLDINGS PTY LTD, ABN 55 657 961 058.

Minimum order: $423.00 AUD. Free shipping over $2,000 AUD. Cold-chain delivery maintains under 2.5°C for 48 hours.
